proposals.evidence: DEDR3213 gives Tamil/Malayalam tiṅkaḷ, Kannada tiṅgaḷ, Kota tigḷ, Toda tïgïḷ moon and Kodagu tiŋga month. These survey tiṅga/tiṅkiya/tiṅguva/tigɨḷ-type moon responses preserve the same southern family with source lateral weakening, vowel and cluster notation. White-moon compounds are treated separately. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1931 explicitly gives Kannada kempu red, kem- red and keñca a red man. Kannada kempa/kempaga and neighbouring Irula kemp-/kenapp-/kanapp-type adjectives are comparative nasal/labial variants of this family with ordinary endings and source vowel notation retained; they are not equated with the Sanskrit red loan family. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
